description: This file defines a `SignificantLocationMonitor` enum that manages monitoring significant location changes on iOS devices using the CoreLocation framework. It provides a static method to start monitoring based on user authorization and location mode, and sends location updates to a gateway in JSON format.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts monitoring significant location changes if the location mode is set to always and the user has authorized such access. When a location update occurs, encodes the data into JSON and sends it via the gateway, optionally executing a beforeSend callback.
